# Copilot continuity instructions

## 대화 로그 필수 프로토콜 (CRITICAL)

- 작업 전 반드시 `docs/conversation-log.md` 참조
- 이전 세션의 TODO와 결정사항 확인 후 작업 시작
- 작업 완료 후 `docs/conversation-log.md` 업데이트 commit + push
- GitHub: https://github.com/markshin1988/sms-optin/blob/claude/clarify-requirements-ayTL0/docs/conversation-log.md
- Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15RcFkB8TY0eyTK2IjF9K_J8UNqXR32yy

## General Rules

- Before answering or changing code, consult `docs/conversation-log.md`
- Keep prior file names, commands, TODOs, and architecture decisions consistent unless Mark explicitly changes them.
- Do not reopen closed issues without regression evidence.
- When current instructions conflict with prior work, state the conflict before editing.
- Do not claim completion without concrete evidence.
- 한국어 응답 시 반드시 존댓말(합니다체) 사용.
- 확인하고 대답하라 — 추측으로 "못한다"고 하지 마라
